ideas.description: Keep I082 as queued: the group-2 freeze dose test. Base: the E049 tip (237 steps; group-2 LR annealed 75%→0 at 90%; last 10% group-2-frozen). Move the group-2 freeze start from 90% to 85% of steps, with the group-2 LR annealed from 70% (the 32 px switch) to 0 by 85%. The frozen-group-2 32 px variant then covers about 36 steps instead of 24. Nothing else changes: step count, group-1 freeze at 75%, whitening detach at 20%, Lookahead and resolution all stay. No new shapes; error_on_recompile stays on. Judge on seeds 13–32 against a same-build E049 baseline, plus seeds 0–2. This settles the W2/W3/W5 crux on whether group 2 has a cliff like E037's.
ideas.expected: Time −0.10 to −0.15 s (about −2.5%, to about 5.05–5.10 s). 20-seed mean −0.25 to 0 pp vs same-build E049 (median −0.08). A loss of ≤0.08 pp supports extending the cascade (rate ≥1.5 s/pp) and feeds the stacking idea. A loss of ≥0.15 pp caps the cascade at 10%.

ideas.description: Explore, proposing a new H2.6 child: the stem needs a steady adaptation signal, not a gradient on every step. Intermittent stem backward in the 28 px phase, which is the most expensive phase (about 71 steps × ~26 ms ≈ 1.8 s). On the E049 tip, on every second step of the 28 px phase (40–70% of steps), use the group-1-detached 28 px step variant. That variant has no group-1 wgrad/dgrad and no BN/GELU backward on the stem maps, and group-1 params get no Muon/SGD update and no momentum-buffer change on those steps. The variant already existed in E037's commit 6293350. On the other steps, run the usual whitening-detached full step with the group-1 LR as scheduled. Do not rescale the LR: single factor. Group 1 still trains on every step at 20/24 px and from 70% to 75% at 32 px, so it still adapts through the 28→32 switch, which E037/E042 say it needs. Lookahead averages every param. Capture the variant in build with channels_last tensors, with error_on_recompile on. Judge on seeds 13–32 against a same-build E049 baseline, plus seeds 0–2.
ideas.expected: About 35 steps save ~5.5–6 ms each, so time falls 0.15–0.22 s (−3 to −4%, to about 4.98–5.05 s). 20-seed mean −0.3 to +0.05 pp (median −0.10). Keep if the loss is ≤0.10 pp and seeds 0–2 ≥0.753 (rate ≥1.5 s/pp, better than the dial). A loss of ≥0.2 pp means stem learning in the 28 px phase is per-step-limited, which closes backward truncation before 75%.

ideas.description: Decisive test of E037's mechanism: a 32 px adaptation cliff, or a linear freeze dose? On the E049 tip, move only the group-1 freeze start from 75% to 71% of steps, just after the 28→32 px switch at 70% (about step 168 of 237). Group 1 then sees about 2 steps at 32 px before its LR reaches 0. Anneal the group-1 LR from its peak to 0 by 71% instead of 75%. The group-2 freeze, whitening detach, step count, resolution, LR and Lookahead are unchanged. The truncated 32 px variant exists, so there are no new shapes; error_on_recompile stays on. Judge on seeds 13–32 against a same-build E049 baseline, plus seeds 0–2. The result also sets the prior for the intermittent-stem idea.
ideas.expected: About 9–10 more frozen steps at ~7.7 ms each: time −0.05 to −0.08 s (~−1.3%, to about 5.13 s). Linear extrapolation from E037 (−0.56 pp for 15% earlier) predicts about −0.15 pp. The cliff reading (H2.6.7) predicts ≤0.05 pp. Median forecast −0.07 pp. A loss of ≤0.05 pp supports H2.6.7 and opens 'move the 32 px switch earlier together with the freeze'. A loss of ≥0.12 pp supports a linear dose and closes the group-1 freeze point at 75%.

ideas.description: Sharpened replacement for I078, gated on the committee's shared crux (do ReLU's saved bytes reach 3%?). Step 1 is offline, with no repo change. On the E049 tip code with synthetic channels_last batch-2000 data, compile the 32 px whitening-detached, group-1-frozen and group-1+2-frozen steps and the 28 px step twice: GELU vs ReLU in all conv groups. Measure GPU kernel time per step (torch.profiler, 20 steps each), and record whether Inductor's ReLU backward saves a bool mask or the fp16 output. Weight the per-step savings by the tip's step counts per phase. Step 2 runs only if the projected saving is ≥3% of train time: commit the ReLU swap, recapture every variant in build with error_on_recompile on, and judge on seeds 13–32 against a same-build E049 baseline plus seeds 0–2. If the projected saving is under 3%, close H6.5's activation branch with no run.
ideas.expected: Most likely (consensus ~2%) step 1 projects a 1–2.5% saving and the branch closes at near-zero cost. If ≥3%: time −3 to −4% (about −0.16 s) and 20-seed mean −0.35 to 0 pp (median −0.15). Keep only if the loss is ≤0.1 pp, which the rate requires.

ideas.description: Conditional stacking and margin idea: run after I082 and the intermittent-stem idea report. Take every per-step cut that passed its own same-build test (I082's 85% group-2 freeze with a loss of ≤0.08 pp; intermittent 28 px stem backward with a loss of ≤0.10 pp; and, if positive, the selection arm of I081). Stack them on the E049 tip and add +0.25 true epoch (237 → about 243 steps). Keep all freeze, detach, resolution, LR and Lookahead points as step fractions. Capture every variant in build with error_on_recompile on. Judge in one build session: same-build E049 on seeds 13–32, this recipe on seeds 13–32, and ar.py on seeds 0–2. Keep if time is ≥1.5% below E049, the 20-seed mean is ≥ E049's same-build mean (target ≥0.7545, the H4 gate), and seeds 0–2 ≥0.753. Record the measured s/pp of the post-cascade dial. If neither cut passed, drop this idea.
ideas.expected: With both cuts: time about 4.95–5.05 s (−0.30 s from the cuts, +0.12 s for the top-up; −3 to −5% vs E049). 20-seed mean −0.1 to +0.1 pp vs E049 (median 0), which moves toward the 0.7545 gate. With one cut: time −1 to −2% at about equal accuracy.

drop.reason: Replaced by a gated version. All four members forecast a ~2% saving and a −0.15 pp loss (0 improve votes), which is a worse rate than the epoch dial. The only open question is whether the saving reaches 3%, and an offline step-time benchmark answers that before any 20-seed run is spent.

structured_output.summary:
State: the E049 tip (5.20 s; 20-seed mean 0.7539, below the 0.7545 H4 gate) has used up the systems levers (E047, I076) and the stem-structure levers (E051). Scalar boosters keep coming back flat. Backward truncation is the only lever that has paid reliably, so the queue now concentrates on it.

- **I082 (kept, priority 4):** tests the group-2 freeze dose, the crux for W2, W3 and W5.
- **New explore idea (H2.6 child):** intermittent stem backward on every other step of the 28 px phase, the most expensive phase (~1.8 s). Group 1 keeps training through the 28→32 switch, which E037/E042 say it needs. Expected saving is 3–4%.
- **H2.6.7:** a group-1 freeze at 71%, which separates a 32 px adaptation cliff from a linear dose. It is cheap and also informs the intermittent-stem prior.
- **I078 replaced:** the ReLU swap is now gated by an offline step-time benchmark, because the committee agrees on a ~2% saving and the 3% threshold is the only open question.
- **Conditional stacking idea:** combines whatever cuts pass with a +0.25 epoch top-up, both to beat E049's time and to reach the margin gate. It follows the E049 pattern (freeze plus top-up dominating the base).
- **I081** (selection on the E049 base) is still running.

All new tests compare against a same-build E049 baseline on seeds 13–32, plus the seeds 0–2 check.
